integrity: Proof uses exact Gaussian convolution, positive-definite Gram inversion, derivative monotonicity and analytic sharpness; standalone numerical checks are supplementary, not infinite proofs. Independent validation was not performed.
scientific_limitations: Three prescribed symmetric Gaussian-kernel nodes; Gaussian scale-mixture integration targets; common diagonal nugget. No assertion for arbitrary target measures, asymmetric designs, optimally chosen locations, or realized noisy-data signs. Historical novelty is provisional.
title: A universal reentrant positivity law for three-node Gaussian-kernel quadrature
